scope.purpose: Repair daily settlement refresh and execution display; distinguish actual JEV model evaluation from fallback in verified settled trades

behavior.display_precision: Derived held minutes use explicit six-decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN; median is computed before rounding. Financial amounts and global numeric limits are unchanged.
behavior.late_settlement_window: Known pending settlement is re-read hourly until 72 hours after the reviewed UTC+8 day's end. The deadline cannot slide; unresolved expiry remains unknown.
behavior.read_failures: Generic optional read failures retain their three-attempt limit. Failed reads may carry previously known pending facts; explicit pending facts also survive mixed partial-read failures.
behavior.cross_midnight: Default runs select at most three older pending days using each account/day's latest revision. Completed or expired revisions stop this scheduling. Current-day research is not blocked by a failed pending-day query.
behavior.jev_read: At most 500 already verified episodes; fixed immutable entry projections bound to scope, symbol, signal, evidence, config, strategy and cutoff. Same 20-second account read budget, at most three seconds per statement, savepoint-isolated.
behavior.jev_denominator: Verified settled episodes, not all candidates, requests or rejected unfilled entries. Missing evidence is unknown, not zero participation.
behavior.jev_failure: Only JEV becomes unknown; verified account totals survive. Retryable JEV reads use the existing bounded read retries, not the settlement window.
behavior.delivery: Existing once-per-day/account/method delivery protection remains unchanged; refreshing stored research does not resend already sent or delivery-unknown messages.

candidate_package.deselection: PG-named cases covered separately in isolated suite, never production
candidate_package.python: Separate Python 3.12 QA venv; production venv has no pytest and was not modified

qa.runtime_import_compatibility: Six overlay modules plus all other dependencies from deployed baseline; production Python import and JEV pure classifications verified

limitations: Settled episode PnL is attributed to the last-close natural day, not account equity daily return
JEV participation among settled trades does not reveal all model calls or unfilled rejected candidates
No model-reviewed settled trades in this population cannot establish JEV incremental predictive value
Late refresh is bounded research scheduling, not settlement reconciliation or trading authority
The 72-hour expiry can leave genuinely unresolved historical coverage unknown; it does not force settlement
Setup volume alternatives remain shadow research; forward sample completion alone never authorizes promotion

rollback.procedure: Stop only the daily-movers timer, wait for the oneshot to be inactive, atomically restore the research symlink, then start the timer. Preserve report revisions.
